reference_summaries.summary: Overhead lifestyle photograph of a grouped handmade crochet pumpkin collection, arranged in descending sizes on a pale cool-grey surface. Chunky, clearly visible stitch construction creates the primary visual texture. Pumpkins use rounded segmented lobes, short cinnamon-stick-like stems, and a warm seasonal accent cluster of dried orange leaves, twine, and cinnamon at upper left; a glossy pale-green leaf dish anchors the lower left. Colours combine muted taupe and cream with saturated teal, aqua, mustard, rust orange, and white.

Front-facing product photograph of a woven natural-fibre basket overflowing with crocheted flowers. The dense bouquet combines recognisable floral silhouettes—rolled roses, tulip-like blooms, bell forms, lavender spikes, daisies, and leafy stems—with prominent soft yarn stitch texture. It is staged against white embossed fabric with a pale textile surface below. A pink oval stitched-edge badge at upper left contains the word “Pattern,” and the basket includes a sewn label bearing the word “Flowers.” The palette is cheerful pastel lavender, pink, cream, yellow, and green, contrasted with the warm brown basket.

Styled seasonal product photograph in a square, front-facing composition: a person in black clothing holds a dramatic crochet bouquet wrapped in dark charcoal paper and tied with a translucent white bow. The bouquet uses high-contrast black, white, orange, yellow, and red yarn components, including floral forms, curling vines, white leaf stems, small ghost-like forms, and a grey animal figure. A warm brown-orange backdrop is framed with scattered autumn maple leaves. White promotional lettering and a small icon at left identify it as a PDF pattern, while large hand-lettered text at right reads “Spooky Bloom Bouquet.”

illustration_category: Handmade fibre-craft product photography, specifically tactile crochet/amigurumi-style botanical and seasonal décor rather than drawn illustration.
line_weight: No drawn outlines; form definition comes from raised crochet ridges, stitch rows, yarn strands, and the edges of physical props.
line_smoothness: Organic and tactile: repeated looped stitches create slightly irregular, soft, ribbed contours rather than clean vector-smooth edges.
level_of_detail: High material detail at close range. Individual stitches, twisted yarn, woven basket fibres, fabric grain, dried leaves, and wrapping materials remain legible, while overall object shapes stay simple and readable.
shape_language: Soft, plush, rounded, and handcrafted. Pumpkins are bulbous segmented circles; flowers simplify into layered petals, spiral rose coils, buds, tubular blossoms, and rounded leaves. Arrangements use abundant naturalistic overlap.
character_proportions: Where present, the small animal and ghost motifs are stylised crochet figures with compact, simplified bodies and oversized rounded heads/features relative to their bodies.
facial_simplicity: The animal face uses minimal high-contrast stitched or attached circular eyes and a tiny nose/muzzle suggestion; ghost figures use extremely reduced dark facial marks.
composition_density: Medium to high. The first reference distributes many objects with breathing room; the second packs the bouquet densely above a stable basket base; the third concentrates the bouquet centrally against a relatively open warm backdrop.
whitespace: Limited but intentional. Negative space is most evident at the right side of the first image and around the central figure/bouquet in the third; the floral basket image is fuller and more contained.
background_complexity: Physical lifestyle-staging backdrops rather than illustrated scenes: pale plain tabletop, white textured textiles, or a warm matte orange-brown surface with sparse autumn leaves. Props reinforce the handmade, seasonal subject without becoming fully scenic.
typography: Mixed promotional overlay typography where present: a pink stitched-look oval badge with white serif italic text in reference 02; white all-caps simple sans-serif utility text and large playful hand-lettered brush-style wording in reference 03. The lettering is placed in open peripheral areas, separate from the central product.
orientation_layout: All three are near-square product-listing compositions. Reference 01 is an overhead flat-lay with a diagonal cascade of objects; reference 02 is a centred, straight-on hero arrangement; reference 03 is a centred waist-up holder-and-bouquet portrait with supporting text zones on both sides.
perspective: Reference 01 uses directly overhead flat-lay perspective; reference 02 uses eye-level to slightly elevated frontal perspective; reference 03 uses a frontal standing portrait view. Shallow depth is used to retain focus on the crochet objects.
colour_behaviour: Yarn colour is generally matte, saturated, and clearly blocked by individual objects, with nuanced darker shadows inside stitch grooves. Palettes pair seasonal warm tones with unexpected cool teal/aqua accents, or use pastel garden tones; the spooky bouquet shifts toward dramatic black-white-orange contrast.
palette_characteristics: Seasonally evocative and craft-friendly: rust, burnt orange, mustard, cinnamon brown, taupe, cream, and autumn leaf red, balanced by turquoise, aqua, lavender, pink, white, green, and charcoal. Warm natural-fibre neutrals ground brighter yarn colours.
contrast: Moderate in the pumpkin and flower-basket scenes, relying on colour separation and texture; high in the spooky bouquet, where black wrapping and clothing sharply frame white and orange crochet elements.
shading_approach: Natural soft photographic lighting with gentle directional shadows. Three-dimensional definition is driven primarily by stitch relief, overlapping elements, and real-material shadow rather than graphic shading.
texture: Extremely tactile and central to the style: visibly chunky crochet loops, ribbing, yarn fuzz, twisted strands, coiled petals, woven wicker, fabric weave, dried foliage, and translucent ribbon. Material authenticity matters more than smooth polish.
emotional_tone: Cosy, handmade, abundant, and giftable, with autumnal warmth; the third reference adds playful gothic/spooky drama without becoming frightening.
apparent_audience: Craft enthusiasts and shoppers interested in handmade seasonal décor or downloadable crochet patterns; the visual presentation is polished for an adult DIY/gifting market, while some motifs are broadly family-friendly.
printable_suitability: Strong as visual inspiration for printable autumn-crochet products when translated into original artwork or a controlled photo-based layout. For home printing, avoid large edge-to-edge dark charcoal/black areas from the spooky styling because they consume substantial ink, preserve enough resolution for stitch texture, and keep small text/busy yarn detail at a legible scale. Light or white backgrounds and a contained warm accent palette will print more economically.
